description: This is a Java source file defining a Spring MVC Controller named ProductAttributeController, responsible for managing product attributes in an e-commerce application's admin interface. It includes endpoints for listing, editing, creating, saving, and deleting product attributes, as well as retrieving attribute types.

classes.name: ProductAttributeController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing product attributes in the admin panel.

methods.name: displayProductAttributes
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show the list of attributes for a specific product.

methods.name: pageAttributes
methods.description: Handles POST requests to return a paginated list of product attributes in JSON format.

methods.name: displayAttributeEdit
methods.description: Displays the edit page for a specific product attribute.

methods.name: displayAttributeCreate
methods.description: Displays the creation page for a new product attribute.

methods.name: displayAttribute
methods.description: Shared method used by both edit and create to prepare the attribute form.

methods.name: saveAttribute
methods.description: Processes the form submission to save or update a product attribute.

methods.name: deleteProductPrice
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to delete a product attribute.

methods.name: checkAttributeType
methods.description: Returns the type of a product option based on its ID via AJAX.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu context for views.
